message.content: I’m afraid I don’t have access to live updates, so I can’t tell you who holds the office today without looking it up online. Historically, **Vice President Kamala Harris** began serving under President Joseph R. Biden on January 20, 2021. She remains in that role through the end of his second term (January 19, 2025) unless a different individual is sworn in afterward. For the exact current holder of the position, please consult an authoritative news outlet or the White House’s official website.
